description.value: Dinakis Mediterranean Grill is a sit-down Greek and Mediterranean restaurant in Port Coquitlam specializing in slow-roasted lamb, souvlaki, and fresh Greek salads made from traditional recipes. The restaurant positions itself as an authentic cultural dining experience with a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Online ordering is available for cyclists who want to call ahead or grab takeout.
